title: Preface
summary: The partial document covers the technical and financial report for the Parque Solar Altiplano project, specifically focusing on the Llanura de Zújar site. It includes sections on the project overview, production forecast for 2025, investors and maintenance details, environmental impact, economic analysis of the project, and potential future expansions.

title: El proyecto
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
1. The name of the solar park project: Altiplano.
2. The installed power capacity of the park: 120 megawatts.
3. The number of solar panels: 312,000.
4. The land area covered: 380 hectares.
5. The location: Zújar plain.
6. The date of connection to the grid: October 2023.
7. The operational mode: selling electricity to the market.
8. The substation transformer capacity: 132 kilovolts.

title: Producción 2025
summary: The partial document covers the annual production for 2025, which was 246.3 gigavatios hour. It also provides a summary of the quarterly production, measured hours of sunlight, and the plant factor for each quarter. The document highlights that the second quarter had the highest production with a plant factor of 32%, while spring experienced dust reduction in production by 6% due to five days of suspended dust. A table is included to show the detailed quarterly production data for 2025.

title: Inversores y mantenimiento
summary: The document covers the use of 28 central inverters with a capacity of 4.4 megawatts and the technical availability of the equipment at 98.6%. It also mentions the use of robotic panel cleaning in 6 cycles and an increase in performance by 4% for bifacial modules in the northern rows after the first annual cleaning.

title: Impacto ambiental
summary: The partial document covers the impact of land management on the environment. It mentions the maintenance of sheep grazing under solar panels, which prevents mechanical clearing in 240 hectares. It also notes bird collision incidents and details a replanting initiative to replace lost vegetation.

title: Economía del proyecto
summary: The partial document covers the economic aspects of a project, including the total investment of 118 million euros, the average sale price of energy in 2025 at 41 euros per megawatt hour, the design life of 30 years, and the operational cash flow coverage of 1.7 times for debt service, with no production insurance activation in 2025.

title: Ampliación
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
1. Phase II of the park has received administrative authorization to add 40 megawatts.
2. Construction will start in the second quarter of 2026.
3. The project includes a 60 megawatt-hour lithium battery storage system.
4. This system will help shift energy delivery to periods of higher prices.
